exposure: White classification of diabetes in pregnancy
outcome: Pregnancy loss (abortions, fetal and neonatal death)
cohort: 209 pregnant Caucasian women with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (95 treated with MDI and 114 using CSII)
finding: The study found that while CSII users had better glycemic control in early pregnancy, the overall course of pregnancy and obstetric outcomes were not significantly different between women using CSII and MDI, suggesting that pregnancy planning and early pregnancy HbA1c are more critical factors.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery did not differ between the CSII and MDI groups.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was measured, but specific values are not provided in the abstract
